title: Capital Credit Checks: Voids, Reissues and Escheat of Unclaimed Payables
content:
# Voids, Reissues and Escheat of Capital Credit Checks

**Treasury standard — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), every patron class.**

## 1. Voids

1.1 A capital credit check reported lost or returned undeliverable may be voided at any time.

1.2 An uncashed check may be voided as stale-dated only after the class's stale period — 180 calendar days in every class — has passed since the check was issued. Calendar days are counted from the day after the check's issue date, the last day being the last day of the count; a void on that last day is permitted.

1.3 A check payout is voided only once. Whether a payout has already been voided is read from the capital ledger: a void entry already naming that payout means it is not voided again.

| Check issued (hypothetical) | Day 180 of the count | Stale-dated void on | Permitted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-01-10 | 2026-07-09 | 2026-07-09 | Yes — on the last day of the count |
| 2026-01-10 | 2026-07-09 | 2026-07-08 | No — the 180 days have not passed |
| 2026-01-10 | — | any date, check reported lost | Yes |

## 2. Reissues

2.1 A voided amount becomes payable again and is reissued on the member's request, to the mailing address on file, as a new check payout that names the voided payout as the one it reissues.

2.2 *Retired:* "the first free reissues of one payout (the class's free reissue count) are free and later ones have the class's reissue fee deducted, counted along the chain of reissues of that payout." This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## 3. Unclaimed payables

3.1 A voided payable not reissued is escheated as state unclaimed property once the dormancy period — 36 calendar months in every class — has passed since the void, after a last-known-address notice mailed 6 months before the escheat.

3.2 Once escheated, the member claims the amount from the state, never from Cedar Fork.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A check voided as undeliverable on 2026-03-02 and never reissued is escheated once 36 calendar months have passed since the void, the notice to the last known address having been mailed 6 months before that escheat.

superseded_clauses: the first check_reissue_free_count reissues of one payout are free and later ones have check_reissue_fee deducted (capital_msr_reissues).
